fields.name: PgDatabases
fields.contract: PgDatabases constructs the non-sharded PostgreSQL database collection: it closes DatabasesBase<PgDbConnectionOptions> and, in its constructor, supplies a new ArgentSea.Pg.DataProviderServiceFactory() together with the bound PgDbConnectionOptions and PgGlobalPropertiesOptions to the DatabasesBase base constructor. It adds no members of its own beyond this constructor.
